jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Private Pricing
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building scalable, customer-obsessed software that powers how the world's largest cloud provider does business? The AWS Private Pricing (AFX) team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help design, build, and operate the systems that enable AWS sellers and customers to negotiate and manage custom pricing agreements at scale. Our team owns the end-to-end experience for AWS Private Pricing — from deal creation through contract execution — serving thousands of internal users across sales, operations, and finance. We build highly available, distributed services that integrate with core AWS commerce platforms including Salesforce CRM, RLM, CLM, and OPM. You'll work on challenging problems at the intersection of complex business workflows and large-scale distributed systems, directly impacting billions of dollars in AWS revenue. This is a high-visibility role where you'll collaborate closely with product managers, tech leads, and cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that simplify and accelerate the private pricing lifecycle for AWS customers worldwide. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The AWS Networking team develops and operates the network platform for all of Amazon including e-commerce products and cloud computing solutions. This platform is industry-leading for its efficiency, throughput and reliability, and it is critical to the success of hundreds of thousands of AWS customers. We have developed and maintained a wide gamut of tools to help planning/scaling/operating our network seamlessly and automatically. We are now facing the next challenge: providing a software ecosystem capable of amalgamating all tools, operations, procedures in a single manageable, scalable, automated entity. ML-Navigators takes care of all aspects related to Machine Learning network support. In the team you'll find diverse skill-sets, knowledge and experience. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Come build community, explore your passions, and do your best work. The Windows Servicing and Delivery (WSD) organization is responsible for delivering protected, productive, and predictable servicing experiences for Windows customers around the world. As security threats evolve and engineering systems grow in scale and complexity, WSD is investing in intelligent automation, large-scale quality analytics, and AI-powered validation platforms that improve the speed, quality, transparency, and reliability of the monthly security fixes delivered across the Windows ecosystem. The Validation team plays a critical role in validating Windows servicing releases, including the monthly security fixes shipped to customers. The team develops and operates modern validation platforms, automation frameworks, telemetry systems, and AI-powered engineering solutions that help identify regressions, quantify release quality, and reduce deployment risk across consumer, enterprise, cloud, and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) environments. Our mission is to help engineering teams make better release decisions faster through trusted validation signals, actionable insights, scalable automation, durable platform services, and responsible use of AI technologies. By transforming validation from a collection of isolated tests into an intelligent engineering platform, we help ensure that monthly Windows security releases meet rigorous standards for reliability, security, and customer quality. As a Software Engineer on the Validation team, you will contribute to software, services, automation systems, and AI-enabled solutions that improve validation effectiveness, engineering productivity, and the quality of monthly Windows security releases. You will work with experienced engineers, validation specialists, and cross-functional partners to design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain cloud services, automation frameworks, telemetry pipelines, quality analytics platforms, and agent-based engineering experiences used to assess release readiness and security-fix quality. This role provides an opportunity to build expertise in cloud-native services, engineering productivity systems, AI-assisted development workflows, large-scale reliability analysis, and modern validation technologies while helping deliver monthly Windows security updates at global scale. In this role, you will help modernize how the quality of Windows security fixes is validated and measured at scale. Your contributions will improve validation efficiency, strengthen confidence in monthly security releases, accelerate issue detection, and help deliver secure, reliable, and high-quality Windows updates to customers around the world. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Software Development Design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain software components that support Windows validation and readiness for monthly security releases. Contribute to cloud-native services and automation platforms that improve validation coverage, scalability, reliability, and engineering efficiency. Develop APIs, workflow integrations, dashboards, and services that enable the collection, processing, and analysis of quality signals. Validation Platform Engineering Build and enhance automation frameworks used to validate monthly Windows security fixes across diverse hardware, software, and deployment environments. Improve mechanisms that detect regressions, identify quality risks, and surface actionable insights earlier in the monthly security-release process. Contribute to systems that increase validation signal quality and reduce manual analysis effort. AI and Intelligent Engineering Use AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and agentic engineering workflows, to improve engineering productivity and software quality. Contribute to AI-powered solutions that automate repetitive engineering activities, improve investigation workflows, and accelerate root cause analysis. Participate in the development of agent-based engineering experiences that improve validation, reliability analysis, and operational efficiency. Telemetry and Analytics Use data and telemetry to understand system behavior, identify trends, measure validation effectiveness, and support data-driven decisions for monthly security-release readiness. Develop dashboards, visualizations, and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into security-fix quality, test effectiveness, release readiness, and operational health. Work with large-scale engineering datasets to improve quality insights and confidence in monthly Windows security releases. Service Reliability and Operations Participate in supporting validation services and platforms in production environments. Assist with investigation and mitigation of service issues, operational incidents, and reliability concerns. Contribute durable fixes, automation, documentation, and monitoring improvements that reduce operational burden and improve platform resiliency. Engineering Excellence Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing activities, and operational reviews. Follow engineering best practices for reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and responsible AI development. Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, and platform capabilities. Collaboration Partner with engineering teams, release teams, servicing organizations, and functional stakeholders to improve validation outcomes and accelerate issue resolution for monthly security releases. Communicate technical concepts clearly and contribute effectively within a highly collaborative engineering environment. jobs.description: Application deadline: Oct 28, 2026 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) control-plane services in air-gapped regions. You will help governments run secure cloud infrastructure at scale. In this role, you will join a team of engineers who build and operate software for EC2's control plane, fleet health, and capacity operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You will own features and services from design through production, make sound trade-offs within your area, and help raise the quality of what the team ships. Commercial tooling often does not exist in isolated regions, so you will build what the team needs instead of configuring an off-the-shelf product. You write code most days, and you are expected to propose better ways to automate capacity and remediation workflows in the systems you own. We operate what we build, so the engineers who design a remediation workflow are the ones it pages.
